title: Near-TP stall exit (stage 1)

fdr.note: Applied per-symbol (PROTOCOL §5.4), not pooled across symbols.

stouffer_convention: z_i = sign(delta_i) * norm.isf(p_i / 2); Z = sum(w_i * z_i) / sqrt(sum(w_i^2)); w_i = sqrt(n_fold_trades); joint_p = 2 * (1 - Phi(|Z|)). Fisher's combined p reported as sensitivity.
